title: Read the page, watch the clip
brief: Pages arrive as scans, forms, slide decks and videos. Layout complexity, volume, the need for grounded fields and where the code may run are all open. Choose how the content gets read.

blocks.text: Four ways to read a document

blocks.md: Microsoft's tool guide separates the choices [[r10]]. For OCR or layout only, use Content Understanding `prebuilt-read` or `prebuilt-layout`, which cost less and return richer layout. For standard forms (invoice, receipt, ID, tax, mortgage) use a Document Intelligence prebuilt model. For contracts and unstructured text use `prebuilt-contract` or a zero-shot custom analyzer. Build directly on a vision model only when you need full control of model and prompt. Each choice shifts work onto you: chunking, confidence and grounding.

options.name: Layout or read only
options.summary: Content Understanding `prebuilt-read` or `prebuilt-layout` return text and structure.
cons: You chunk and interpret the result
options.bestWhen: You feed a search index and text plus structure is enough.
options.avoidWhen: You need typed fields with confidence.

options.name: Document Intelligence prebuilt or custom
options.summary: Prebuilt models for standard forms, and custom models from as few as 5 labeled samples.
pros: No forced migration to newer services
Containers are the only on-premises or air-gapped option
Confidence and grounding come with the output
options.bestWhen: Stable forms at volume, or a no-cloud rule.
options.avoidWhen: Contracts and unstructured text with changing layouts.

options.name: Content Understanding analyzer
options.summary: Analyzers for documents, images, audio and video, with `prebuilt-contract` and zero-shot custom analyzers.
options.bestWhen: Mixed modalities or unstructured content that needs fields.
options.avoidWhen: Air-gapped sites, or stable forms that a prebuilt model already covers.

options.name: Vision LLM called directly
options.summary: Send page images to a vision model with your own prompt.
pros: Full control of model and prompt
cons: You build chunking, confidence and grounding
Weak on small text, rotation and non-Latin scripts
options.bestWhen: Low volume, odd layouts or answers that need inference.
options.avoidWhen: Audit trails need confidence scores and bounding regions.

blocks.title: Pick a document pipeline
blocks.prompt: Change the layout, the volume, where it runs and whether you need grounding.

plain.why: Cheap and richer than raw text.

forms.why: Prebuilt invoice, receipt, ID, tax, mortgage.

air.why: Containers are the only on-premises option.

need.why: Confidence and grounding come with it.

forms.why: Prebuilt DI is the closer fit.

need.why: Confidence and grounding are yours to build.

blocks.takeaway: The cheapest option that gives the evidence you need wins. A vision LLM leads only when you accept building grounding yourself.

blocks.title: Document tool decision path
blocks.alt: A standard form goes to a Document Intelligence prebuilt model. Otherwise, if no fields or reasoning are needed use layout or read, and if they are needed use a Content Understanding analyzer.
blocks.caption: On premises or air-gapped sites route to Document Intelligence containers first.

items.symptom: A table splits at a page break and rows are lost
items.cause: Pages were parsed one by one
items.fix: Use the Content Understanding skill in AI Search, which handles cross-page tables [[r12]], or merge tables after layout extraction.

items.symptom: Small print and rotated scans come back wrong
items.cause: A vision LLM was used alone, and small text and rotation are known weak spots
items.fix: Run layout extraction first, or send the page at `original` detail after deskewing.

items.symptom: Cost jumps after video segmentation is enabled
items.cause: Segmentation spends generative model tokens even when no fields are defined
items.fix: Enable `enableSegment` only where scene segments are used.

items.symptom: Output shape changes after a service update
items.cause: Production calls `2026-06-01-preview`, which has no SLA
items.fix: Pin the GA version `2025-11-01` for production and test preview versions elsewhere.

items.symptom: A no-cloud requirement appears late in the project
items.fix: Ask about on-premises needs first. Document Intelligence containers are the only on-premises option among these tools.

items.title: Go deeper: video through Content Understanding

blocks.md: The video analyzer samples about one frame per second, resizes frames to 512 x 512 pixels and transcribes speech only, not music or ambient sound [[r11]]. It offers key frames, shot detection (`cameraShotTimesMs`) and custom segmentation (`enableSegment`). Fast events and small on-screen text are lost at that sampling. For slides or fine text, extract higher-resolution frames yourself and send them at `original` detail (inference from the documented limits).

items.title: Go deeper: what the preview version adds

blocks.md: GA API `2025-11-01` is the production choice. `2026-06-01-preview` adds agentic mode, in-page segmentation, signature detection and document metadata, and is not covered by an SLA [[r10]]. Document Intelligence v4.0 is GA as `2024-11-30` and needs no forced migration.

quiz.q: Invoices with a stable layout must be processed in an air-gapped plant. Which choice fits the dials?
options: A Content Understanding analyzer on the preview API, which adds agentic mode for stable invoice layouts
Document Intelligence containers, the only on-premises option among these tools
A vision LLM called directly, since it needs no templates
Content Understanding `prebuilt-layout`, the lowest cost layout option
quiz.explain: On-premises and air-gapped sites can only use Document Intelligence containers among these tools. The analyzer and the layout service are cloud services. A vision LLM needs a model endpoint and gives no confidence scores for invoice fields.

quiz.q: A production pipeline calls Content Understanding with the version below and its output shape changed after a service update. What is the right fix?
options: Raise the vision model detail level to `original`
Switch from Content Understanding to a vision LLM and accept the loss of field extraction
Retry failed calls with exponential backoff
Pin the GA version `2025-11-01` for production and test previews elsewhere
quiz.explain: The preview version is not covered by an SLA and can change. GA `2025-11-01` is the production choice. Detail levels, backoff and a different tool do not address a changing API contract.

quiz.q: Select every true statement about the Content Understanding video analyzer.
options: It samples about one frame per second.
Frames are resized to 512 x 512 pixels.
It transcribes music and ambient sound.
Segmentation spends generative tokens even when no fields are defined.
quiz.explain: Sampling is about 1 fps at 512 x 512, and segmentation uses generative tokens even without fields. Only speech is transcribed, so music and ambient sound are not.

takeaways: Pick the cheapest tool that returns the evidence you need: layout, form model, analyzer or vision LLM
On-premises needs point to Document Intelligence containers
Use the GA Content Understanding version for production
Video sampling at about 1 fps and 512 x 512 loses fast events and fine text
